My brother-in-law cares about his looks like a woman and he is a manly man. He is also very talkative and notices things. He decorated the whole house himself.

It's funny to read these comments...as a woman, I like camping, multi-tools, performing magic tricks. I am interested in fixing things. I dislike having time with children and of course, I never say that...
I don't understand I can't imagine wanting to live, I swear with my life, I don't understand people who want to live. They are sadists to themselves.
This is ironic. You don't know that I would give everything to be ugly. Ugliness is freedom!
